plan: Since the private value is $39, I should bid slightly below this value to maximize profit if I win. Bidding exactly $39 risks zero profit if I win. A bid of $38.9 can potentially win while ensuring a small profit margin. Rational bidders will bid close to their values, but slightly lower to ensure profit.

Given my value of $41, I should bid slightly below this to maximize profit while still having a good chance of winning. Rational bidders will bid just below their value. To outbid them while minimizing my cost, I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of the maximum value ($20) and my value ($41). This strategy balances winning likelihood and profit.

Given my private value of $25, I should bid slightly less than this to ensure a positive profit if I win. Since the value range is $0-$20, it's rational to assume others will bid close to their values. To maximize profit while maintaining a high chance of winning, I'll bid slightly above $20, say $20.1. This ensures I win if others bid near their maximum value of $20, while still securing a profit if my bid is the highest.
